  - alert: Get 7% off with coupon code ''OCT26''. Valid until October 20, 2026.
  - banner:

    - text: › Become a Partner
    - heading "List Your Business on MarHire" [level=1]
    - paragraph: MarHire connects thousands of international travelers with local Moroccan service providers. Join our verified partners already growing their bookings across Agadir, Marrakech, Casablanca, and beyond. Getting listed is simple and free to start.
    - button "Apply Now"
    - link "Chat on WhatsApp":
      - /url: https://wa.me/212660745055?text=Hello%2C%20I'm%20interested%20in%20partnering%20with%20MarHire.%20Could%20you%20please%20provide%20more%20information%20about%20the%20partnership%20program%3F
    - heading "Why Partner with MarHire?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Join our verified partners across Morocco
    - heading "Confirmed Bookings, Not Enquiries" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Every booking we send you is confirmed and secured by the traveller in advance. No price shoppers, no wasted time.
    - heading "No Fees to Join" [level=3]
    - paragraph: There are no listing fees, no subscriptions and no monthly charges. You only earn when you deliver a booking.
    - heading "We Handle the Traveller" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Our support team looks after the client on WhatsApp 24/7 in 10 languages, before, during and after the service. You focus on delivering it. Our partner team supports you in Arabic, French and English.
    - heading "What Can You List?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: We work with established, insured local businesses in four categories
    - heading "Car Rentals" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Economy, compact, SUV, 7-seater and luxury vehicles from recent model years with full insurance
    - heading "Private Drivers" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Airport transfers, intercity travel, day trips and chauffeur services with sedans, SUVs, minivans and minibuses
    - heading "Boat Rentals" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Yacht charters, sailing boats, fishing trips and speedboats in Agadir and Tangier
    - heading "Tours & Activities" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Desert experiences, day trips, camel and horse riding, quads and buggies, surf lessons, hot-air balloons and more
    - paragraph: Offer something else? Contact us, we add categories when there's demand.
    - heading "Getting Started is Simple" [level=2]
    - paragraph: From application to your first booking in four steps. Our partner team guides you through each one on WhatsApp.
    - text: "1"
    - heading "Apply" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Fill in the form below. It takes five minutes. Have your RC document ready.
    - text: "2"
    - heading "Get Verified" [level=3]
    - paragraph: We review your documents and insurance and call you on WhatsApp to go through how we work together. Most applications are reviewed within a few working days.
    - text: "3"
    - heading "Accept MarHire Terms" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Accept the MarHire partner terms and we set up your fleet or services on our side.
    - text: "4"
    - heading "Receive Bookings" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Start receiving confirmed bookings from international travellers. We take care of the client — you take care of the service.
    - heading "Become a MarHire Partner" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Fill out the form below to start the process. Our team is excited to learn about your business and will contact you shortly after reviewing your application.
